Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULE: frontend/noise_spec.py -- the Stim-representable Pauli noise-spec layer of the simulator
frontend. Three noise families (all Stim-Pauli, NOT analog/joint-L/leakage truth): the plain
StimPauliNoiseSpec depolarizing projection (DEPOLARIZE1 after 1q, DEPOLARIZE2 after 2q, X_ERROR
before Z measurement), the location-aware TargetedStimNoiseSpec (ordered StimNoiseRule list built
by the NoiseBuilder fluent API), and the evaluator-only SourceStimPauliProjectionSpec (a reduced
Pauli projection of a SourceTimeline into per-cycle probabilities). apply_stim_pauli_noise inserts
the noise ops into a CircuitIR at the right positions. The module imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb
(numpy + math only), so EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope
is therefore {} (the AST reconcile refuses any gpu_bound claim on a torch-less module).
TWENTY-FIVE public units (AST reconcile: top-level public defs + every public method of a top-level
class + the load-bearing __post_init__ dunder of each frozen dataclass -- five here):
* 1 module function: apply_stim_pauli_noise.
* StimPauliNoiseSpec (frozen dataclass, 3): __post_init__ + is_trivial + to_manifest.
* StimNoiseRule (frozen dataclass, 2): __post_init__ + to_manifest.
* TargetedStimNoiseSpec (frozen dataclass, 3): __post_init__ + is_trivial + to_manifest.
* SourceStimPauliRule (frozen dataclass, 4): __post_init__ + probability_for + to_public_manifest
+ to_manifest.
* SourceStimPauliProjectionSpec (frozen dataclass, 5): __post_init__ + is_trivial + source_timeline
+ to_manifest + to_evaluator_manifest.
* NoiseBuilder (plain class, 7): after_gate, after_gate_type, after_all_gates, before_measurement,
before_measurement_type, during_idle, build (its __init__ is private -> not a unit).
CPU discipline. Every unit runs on numpy/math only -- apply_stim_pauli_noise transforms a CircuitIR
in memory (no Stim, no PyMatching, no Simulator run), so the tests are fast and deterministic. The
workhorse is EXACT-STRUCTURE pinning: the transformed CircuitIR's (name, targets, args) step tuples
and the noise_projection metadata dict are pinned against an INDEPENDENT from-scratch expectation
(NOT the module's own to_manifest). SourceStimPauliRule.probability_for is pinned against a
from-scratch recompute of the logit sigmoid base*/z_scale/sensitivity map and of the payload-probability
identity map (NEVER the module's own call). Every validation RAISE asserts its EXACT message via
str(excinfo.value)==... (KeyError via .args[0]) -- mutmut wraps/roundtrips string literals, so a
substring match= lets them survive but exact-equality kills them.
ISOLATION CONTRACT (load-bearing). The public-artifact SourceStimPauliProjectionSpec.to_manifest()
(and SourceStimPauliRule.to_public_manifest()) must NOT leak the evaluator-only source-conditioning
fields (payload_key / map_kind / base_p / sensitivity / z_scale / timeline name / coupling_mode) that
to_evaluator_manifest() carries. The tests pin BOTH manifests' exact key sets AND assert the public
manifest's serialized JSON contains NONE of those tokens while the evaluator one does -- with an
assert_discriminates variant demonstrating a leak would be caught.
The module's PRIVATE helpers (_apply_targeted_stim_noise / _apply_source_stim_pauli_projection and the
_append_*/_rule_matches_*/_resolve_*/_validate_noise_targets/_payload_value_for_targets/_gate_arity/
_optional_targets/_strict_* routing seams) are NOT public units and are NOT reconciled/scored, but ARE
exercised + mutation-covered here via the public apply_stim_pauli_noise + NoiseBuilder paths AND direct
value-pins/exact-message raises (mutmut is coverage-guided: every covered helper line yields counted
mutants, so each is given teeth -- notably parametrized coverage of EVERY gate name in the 1q/2q
unitary sets + every Z-measurement + every noise-instruction alias so the module-level set-element
string mutations are killed, and each _strict_* / _validate_* guard tripped through every route).
NO exemptions + NO out_of_scope: every guard is REACHABLE through a constructor/apply route (checked,
not assumed -- the D13 default-arg/guard-route lesson): the before_measure non-Z NotImplementedError,
every StimNoiseRule position/match_kind/noise/args raise, the SourceStimPauliRule map_kind/base_p/
sensitivity/z_scale/target_filter raises, the projection-spec empty-rules/missing-payload/qec_round/
omit raises, and the _validate_noise_targets/_resolve_noise_name raises are all tripped by a sabotaged
input. The lone # pragma: no cover branch (matched_step-None guard on a non-idle rule) is structurally
unreachable -- match_kind!='idle' always carries a matched_step -- so coverage never counts it and
mutmut never mutates it (no exemption needed).
